title: Cousins in Binary Tree
description: Determine if two nodes are cousins (same depth, different parents).
pseudocode:
1. function isCousins(root, x, y):
2.   queue = [[root, null, 0]]
3.   while queue is not empty:
4.     level_size = queue.length
5.     data = {}
6.     for i = 0 to level_size - 1:
7.       node, parent, depth = queue.pop()
8.       if node.val == x or node.val == y: data[node.val] = [parent, depth]
9.       if node.left: queue.push([node.left, node.val, depth + 1])
10.      if node.right: queue.push([node.right, node.val, depth + 1])
11.    if x in data and y in data: return data[x][0] != data[y][0]

steps.note: Initialize queue with root (1), parent null, depth 0
Push children of 1 (nodes 2 and 3) to queue
Push children of 2 and 3 (nodes 4 and 5) to queue
Found target x=4 and y=5 at depth 2
Compare parents: node 4 parent is 2, node 5 parent is 3. Different parents, same depth: True
